videos.title: Rewriting the Migration Path | SAP at AIPCon 9
videos.description: Sebastian from SAP reveals how Palantir's AI agents are fundamentally rewriting the path to SAP in the cloud—collapsing migrations from months to weeks, reducing costs dramatically, and delivering business value from day one through purpose-built agents that handle assessment, transformation, mapping, and validation in parallel.

videos.title: End-to-End Intelligence: Transforming Mortgage with AI | Moder at AIPCon 9
videos.description: Michael Middleman shares Moder’s strategic partnership with Palantir, and pilot first customer Freedom Mortgage, to bring end-to-end intelligence to mortgage operations and pioneer AI automation that delivers transparency, empowers on the dream of homeownership, and enables industry-wide transformation.

videos.title: Palantir CEO Alex Karp Opening Remarks | AIPCon 9
videos.description: Palantir CEO Alex Karp takes the stage at AIPCon 9 to share the values of Palantir, our role on the global stage, and the connection between our work on the battlefield and the commercial arena.

videos.title: Magical on the Front Lines | Intro at AIPCon 9
Chad & Craig | Data Migrations with AI FDE
videos.description:
Accelerating data migrations from 5 months to 5 days with AI FDE.

Craig Roberts shows Chad Wahlquist how Palantir AIP is enabling organizations to move beyond legacy systems to new operations and outcomes.

videos.title: Palantir and Apex | Satellite Manufacturing
videos.description: Apex, in partnership with Palantir, is revolutionizing satellite manufacturing by cutting launch timelines from years to days and powering the West's edge in the modern space race.

videos.title: Chad & Konrad | Embedded Ontology
videos.description:
The Embedded Ontology connects AI with operations at the edge.

Konrad Eilers shows Chad Wahlquist how Palantir powers critical outcomes in harsh and disconnected environments.

videos.title: Palantir and Hadean | UK Stories
videos.description:
Deploying into classified environments is hard. Organisations must endure long procurement cycles, stringent security requirements, and building software infrastructure that meets defence standards.

See how Palantir is helping British defence companies like Hadean deliver cutting-edge software to the warfighter at the speed of innovation.

videos.title: Palantir and the NHS | UK Stories
videos.description:
The NHS Federated Data Platform, powered by Palantir, is driving up the number of NHS operations while bearing down on waiting lists.

Each hospital has its own version of the software of which it controls. Yet, because it is the same kind of software, they can share information with other hospitals and NHS organisations simply and securely where that can help improve care for patients.

Hear about the programme, its benefits, and the partnership with Palantir from NHS England's Ming Tang, Chief Data and Analytics Officer and interim Chief Digital and Information Officer; Ayub Bhayat, Director of Data and Analytics; Rebecca Llewellyn, Director of Data Management and Transformation; and Palantir engineers Jasmine Brown, Ethan Dodd, and Sam Rhodes.

videos.title: The Future of AI and Work
videos.description: Palantir Chief Architect Akshay Krishnaswamy joins Senior Counselor Jordan Hirsch to discuss the future of work and artificial intelligence. Building on the Working Intelligence project showcasing AI deployments that enhance workers (https://workingintelligence.ai), Akshay explains how properly built AI systems can liberate human creativity and capture the vast untapped intelligence in the people on the frontline -- making those with the deepest expertise not expendable, but ever more valuable.
